items.question: Which eternal three-eyed goddess is worshipped with red color and six right-hand attributes?
premises: Her right hands hold six listed objects.
The worshipper describes her as red-colored.
items.inference: The verse identifies Bhavānī as the red-colored eternal goddess worshipped with those attributes.
uncertainties: Compound boundaries and exact object list depend on sandhi.
items.plain_english: With right hands holding goad, book, flower, sword, skull, and fearlessness, radiant with maṇikya ornaments, three-eyed, eternal Bhavānī, I worship, red-colored.
